issues.problem: This OAuth client credential bundle contains a live client secret in plaintext.
issues.failure_scenario: If the file is backed up, shared, or committed anywhere, the OAuth client can be abused to mint tokens for the associated Google project.
issues.fix_instruction: Rotate the OAuth client secret, delete the file from tracked storage, and load the credential from a secret manager or user-specific config path.

issues.problem: This is a second plaintext copy of the same OAuth client secret bundle, which increases the chance of accidental exposure and makes rotation harder.
issues.failure_scenario: If either copy leaks through backups or sync, the OAuth client secret can be replayed even after the other copy is deleted.
issues.fix_instruction: Rotate the OAuth client secret, consolidate the credential into one secured location, and delete every plaintext duplicate.
